title: geracium aureum
intro: Geracium aureum, commonly known as the American geranium or spotted geranium, is a perennial plant belonging to the Geraniaceae family, native to North and South America. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice in herbal medicine. The therapeutic actions of Geracium aureum include its use in treating digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniin, geraniol, and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
